notes: DRAFT for M7-P6 (+ fix). Session list of Sensei's Lessons. Same keys as content/tutorial/sensei-lessons.json plus 'practice' (one-line goal shown in the safe practice room, which can't be failed) and 'earliestSession'. Session 1 is the tutorial: Move, Counter and Strike play on the tutorial floor, and Bow plays on the first return home after the door home. After session 1, at most one NEW lesson per session: Dash (2), Insights (3), Decorating (4). Perfect Counter, Block and Step-out are merged in from the run-based list (content/tutorial/sensei-lessons.json) with their exact screens. Each one plays the first time it comes up, on or after its earliestSession, and still counts toward the one-per-session limit. If it comes up early, it waits. Button names match the UI (COUNTER, STRIKE, DASH, Bow). One sentence per screen.
speaker: sensei

lessons.trigger: First open of the game (before the tutorial floor)
screens: Tap where you want to go, or use the stick.
You punch all by yourself when you're close.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

screens: See the red circle? An attack is coming.
Tap COUNTER when the circle is almost full.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

screens: Your STRIKE button is glowing.
Tap it for a big, strong hit.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

lessons.trigger: First return to the Home Dojo, right after the tutorial's door home (session 1)
screens: We bow when we come in.
It shows respect for the dojo.
lessons.success: Thank you. That was a good bow.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

lessons.trigger: First time two attacks will land together
screens: Too many circles? Dash away.
Tap DASH to zoom out of danger.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

screens: After a fight, you can pick one Insight.
It helps you until you go home.
lessons.success: Good choice. Which one did you pick?
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

screens: You found something for your dojo!
Drag it to any spot you like.
lessons.success: Your dojo looks more like you now.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

lessons.trigger: First time it comes up: the first Perfect Counter without help
screens: Tap when the circle is almost full.
That is a Perfect Counter.
It fills your Focus fast!
lessons.practice: Counter when the circle is almost full.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

lessons.trigger: First time it comes up: the first Block (COUNTER pressed a little early)
screens: That was a Block. Good guarding!
Wait a tiny bit longer for Perfect.
lessons.practice: Wait a tiny bit, then tap COUNTER.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

lessons.trigger: First time it comes up: the player walks out of a red circle
screens: Smart! Stepping out works too.
lessons.practice: Walk out of the red circle.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.
